Title: Robotic surgery — Ophthalmology

PRECEYES Surgical System is being used for vitreoretinal surgeries. This is a single-arm robot that is telemanipulated by a surgeon. This system attaches to the head of the operating room table and provides surgeons with increased precision with the assistance of the intuitive motion controller. Preceyes is the only robotic instrument to be CE certified. Some other companies like Forsight Robotics, Acusurgical that raised 5.75 M€ (France), and Horizon (US) are working in this field. The da Vinci Surgical System, though not specifically designed for ophthalmic procedures, uses telemanipulation to perform pterygium repairs and ex vivo corneal surgeries.
